name: Cognitive Biases in Build Decisions (Signature Edition)
title: Cognitive Biases in Build Decisions (Signature Edition)
description: Signature reading: Name the biases to disarm them: process is the defense. Sunk cost, confirmation bias, anchoring, and optimism distort build decisions systematically. Naming them in the process is the defense - bias thrives in unnamed darkness.
how_it_works: Signature decision practice: no evidence, no decision. The Signature record links the choice to its proof - data, test, or analysis - so any future engineer can re-derive the why.
key_points: Signature reading: Name the biases to disarm them: process is the defense.
Sunk cost: past spend must not drive future choice.
Confirmation: ask what evidence would change your mind.
Anchoring: get independent estimates before sharing yours.
